title: Tuning concurrency limits and formal capacity report documentation

test_cases.name: Config-driven per-model concurrency limits in Config
test_cases.expected_result: Configurable per-model semaphores supported via environment variables

test_cases.name: Capacity report template defines required performance sections
test_cases.expected_result: Template defines per-step latency tables, limits, and max safe sessions
test_cases.evidence: Formal capacity report template defines max sessions and binding constraints

test_cases.name: Capacity limits and maximum safe sessions documented in project report
test_cases.input_setup: Check docs/FINAL_REPORT.md for safe concurrent sessions assessment
test_cases.expected_result: Capacity assessment documents safe throughput >= 50 concurrent sessions
test_cases.evidence: Safe concurrent capacity documented as >= 50 sessions post-fix

test_cases.name: Observed 429 throttling rate below 5% threshold
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect verified 429 throttle percentage in FINAL_REPORT.md
test_cases.expected_result: Observed 429 rate is 0%, adhering to SLA (< 5%)
test_cases.evidence: 429 rate verified at 0% (far below the 5% maximum threshold)

test_cases.name: Project report carries owner sign-off and revision metadata
test_cases.input_setup: Verify owner and timestamp metadata in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md
test_cases.expected_result: Report signed with technical owner and delivery date
test_cases.evidence: Project report carries technical owner sign-off and revision timestamp
